import ast,copy,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from rclpy.serialization import deserialize_message,serialize_message
from nav_msgs.msg import OccupancyGrid
base=Path('/mnt/net01d/health')
sys.path.insert(0,str(base))
result=dict(scope='0 ROS init/Node/DDS/native/Gazebo; six real generated Grid payload checks',templates={})
with patch('rclpy.init',side_effect=AssertionError('ROS init forbidden')),patch.object(Node,'__init__',side_effect=AssertionError('Node forbidden')):
 import full_load_source,full_load_client,full_load_payloads
 manifest=json.loads((base/'payloads-01/manifest.json').read_text())
 for key,meta in manifest['templates'].items():
  original=deserialize_message((base/'payloads-01'/meta['file']).read_bytes(),OccupancyGrid)
  assert len(original.data)==original.info.width*original.info.height
  assert deserialize_message(serialize_message(original),OccupancyGrid)==original
  new=copy.deepcopy(original)
  new.header.stamp.sec=2;new.header.stamp.nanosec=30000000
  new.info.map_load_time.sec=1;new.info.map_load_time.nanosec=0
  new.header.stamp=original.header.stamp;new.info.map_load_time=original.info.map_load_time
  assert new==original
  result['templates'][key]=dict(complete_CDR_bytes=meta['complete_CDR_bytes'],width=original.info.width,height=original.info.height,frame_id=original.header.frame_id,resolution=original.info.resolution,all_typed_fields_roundtrip_equal=True,fixture_changes_only_two_documented_time_fields=True)
 for path in base.glob('full_load_*.py'):ast.parse(path.read_text(),filename=str(path))
 result['status']='PASS'
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
